sql: SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN ps.skill = 'sql' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(DISTINCT fp.posting_key) AS share_of_listings_mentioning_sql FROM fct_posting AS fp JOIN posting_skills AS ps ON fp.posting_key = ps.posting_key WHERE fp.is_open = TRUE AND fp.remote_us = TRUE AND fp.family = 'data_analyst'
